name: ZSF_DS_QUOTA
description: This table contains the quotas allocated to the sales representative.

columns.name: DS_QUOTA_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the quota metric

columns.name: DS_QUOTA_NUMBER
columns.description: Public surrogate key for this table

columns.name: METRIC_DIM1_KEY
columns.description: Dimension 1 for which the quota is allocated

columns.name: METRIC_DIM2_KEY
columns.description: Dimension 2 for which the quota is allocated

columns.name: METRIC_DIM3_KEY
columns.description: Dimension 3 for which the quota is allocated

columns.name: METRIC_DIM4_KEY
columns.description: Dimension 4 for which the quota is allocated

columns.name: METRIC_DIM5_KEY
columns.description: Dimension 5 for which the quota is allocated

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Date used to identify the period for which this quota is allocated

columns.name: METRIC_CODE
columns.description: Metric code associated to the quota

columns.name: CORP_METRIC_VALUE
columns.description: Metric value in the corporate currency

columns.name: METRIC_VALUE
columns.description: Metric value in the entered currency

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code in which the metric is entered

columns.name: CURRENCY_CONV_RATE
columns.description: Currency conversion rate from entered currency to corporate currency

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Optional comments to describe the value entered

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
